description:
## Why

bettertls::pathbuilding::tc60 diagnosis (see PKIX-lwr9.4 comment of 2026-05-11): pkix-path-builder correctly enumerates 4 candidate chains via build_path_candidates. The first DFS-order candidate uses SHA-1 ECDSA intermediates (rejected by DefaultVerifier per project policy). A valid SHA-256-only path exists at candidate position N>0. The pkix-difftest limbo loader calls build_path() (single-shot wrapper returning only the first candidate), so it never sees the valid alternatives.

This is the same pattern PKIX-t0w4 fixed on the PKITS side.

## What

1. In the pkix-difftest limbo loader (path TBD by implementor; grep for build_path callsites), replace the single-shot build_path() call with an iteration over build_path_candidates that tries each via validate_path until one returns Ok or the iterator is exhausted.
2. Re-run the limbo baseline (cargo test -p pkix-difftest --test limbo or equivalent).
3. tc60 should flip from StricterThanWild(Fail) to Agreement(Pass).
4. Confirm no regression on other limbo cases.

## Acceptance

- [ ] limbo loader iterates build_path_candidates and selects first valid chain.
- [ ] tc60 flips to Agreement in baseline-limbo.json.
- [ ] StricterThanWild count drops by 1 (26 -> 25 or fewer).
- [ ] No regression on PKITS or other limbo cases.
- [ ] baseline-limbo-analysis.md updated to reflect new counts.

## Out of scope

- The build_first_valid_path<V> helper API in pkix-path-builder (filed as PKIX-lwr9.4.2).
- The other 6 residual bettertls::pathbuilding::* cases (gt_agreement=true; pkix-path correctly stricter).

## Filed by

Split from PKIX-lwr9.4 after Mark chose 'both' (harness fix + helper API) 2026-05-11.
title: pkix-difftest: limbo loader iterates build_path_candidates when validate_path fails
